MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Gorilla Glue felt useful alongside my screws and anchors because it could support small repair and assembly jobs.",
    "The glue connected with the practical fastening work suggested by several of my recent choices. It was the only recommendation I would choose now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Looking at bags that fit Panasonic vacuums suggests maintaining an existing vacuum, so a Sanitaire vacuum did not feel like a natural next purchase.",
    "Wire brushes and cutting discs require particular tools and tasks that my nails, screws and anchors do not establish.",
    "Spray bottles, replacement spray heads and a large utility tub did not address a current need. Medicine cups also gave me no reason to choose medium latex gloves.",
    "Heat shrink tubing and kitchen-and-bath caulk serve specific electrical or sealing jobs that I have not shown an interest in doing."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My fastening purchases seemed to be treated as interest in workshop supplies generally, even when the recommended items serve unrelated jobs.",
    "My vacuum bags and medicine cups seemed to be stretched into broader cleaning and medical needs, beyond what those purchases actually suggest."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Several recent choices involve fastening wood or mounting things, so the purpose of those items matters more to me than a loose connection to maintenance supplies.",
    "Compatibility matters: vacuum bags fit particular vacuums, and grinder accessories or spray heads need matching equipment that my history does not show.",
    "I choose selectively when something supports a current task; a possible household use alone is not enough."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The glue fit my apparent repair and assembly needs, but most recommendations stretched those needs into unrelated maintenance tasks."
}
